LYFE Marketing vs VEXI: Which Is Better for Realtors in 2026?
LYFE Marketing and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.
Compare LYFE Marketing vs VEXI. Pricing and features side-by-side. See why 1,000+ realtors choose VEXI.

LYFE Marketing is a social media marketing agency founded in 2011, with SEO, PPC, email marketing and graphic design services alongside [1]. VEXI makes posts, videos, designs and captions from what you ask for. The two overlap on social media, and in many ways they fit together.

LYFE Marketing says it has managed more than 2,000 social media campaigns since 2011, for small businesses in real estate, ecommerce, law, dentistry, food and hospitality and more [1]. LYFE Marketing’s social media management starts at $750 a month for 12 image posts on Facebook and Instagram, with a one-time $300 setup fee [2]. LYFE Marketing’s plans with vertical videos on Instagram and TikTok are $1,350 a month for 12 posts and $1,550 for 20, and its separate short video management starts at $500 a month [2][3].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
The two overlap on social media and work in different ways. Here is what each one does.

LYFE Marketing’s social media plans include custom content creation, page monitoring and responding, and sponsored posts and follower ads [2]. It asks clients to share their own photos and videos, and creates content around your industry when you have little media to share [2].

LYFE Marketing lists three social media plans: $750 a month for 12 image posts on Facebook and Instagram, $1,350 for 12 vertical videos on Instagram and TikTok, and $1,550 for 20 vertical videos [2]. It adds a one-time $300 setup fee, bills ad spend separately and lists no long-term contracts [2].

LYFE Marketing’s short video management is $500 a month for 12 vertical videos, $800 for 20, or $1,400 for a custom plan, on Instagram and TikTok [3]. Its $1,350 and $1,550 social media plans also include vertical videos [2].
VEXI includes video on every plan.
